doc.name: EcoCheck
doc.instructions: Read-only access to EcoCheck (ecocheck.ai), the Vietnamese GHG inventory platform. For "must my facility do a GHG inventory?" call check_ghg_inventory_obligation; for 2026 rules call get_ghg_regulations; for EU CBAM call cbam_scope_check (is a CN code covered), cbam_default_value (EU default value + mark-up) and estimate_cbam_cost (certificate cost after the free-allocation adjustment); always use the exact 8-digit CN code. For a GHG inventory (ISO 14064-1 / GHG Protocol) call calculate_ghg_inventory with the activity data (ask for the official grid factor of the year for electricity), ghg_emission_factors to cite defaults, and iso14064_guide for method questions. For topics use search_ecocheck then get_article. Articles are in Vietnamese; CBAM tools answer in English data, explain them in the language of the user. Estimates are indicative, not a CBAM declaration.

tools.name: check_ghg_inventory_obligation
tools.title: Check GHG inventory obligation (Vietnam)
tools.description: Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Thresholds: 3,000 tCO2e, 1,000 TOE or 65,000 t of waste per year.

sector.description: cong-nghiep (industry), nhiet-dien (power), van-tai (freight transport), toa-nha (commercial building), chat-thai (solid waste), khac (other).

annualEnergyToe.description: Annual energy use in TOE (tonnes of oil equivalent).

annualElectricityKwh.description: Annual electricity use in kWh (used if TOE is unknown; converted at 0.0001543 TOE/kWh per Appendix I of Circular 02/2014/TT-BCT, so 1,000 TOE ≈ 6.48 million kWh).

annualEmissionsTco2e.description: Annual GHG emissions in tonnes CO2e.

tools.name: get_ghg_regulations
tools.title: Vietnam GHG, carbon market and CBAM rules (2026)
tools.description: Key verified facts for Vietnam GHG compliance in 2026: Decision 42/2026 facility list (2,441 facilities), reporting deadline 31/3/2027, pilot ETS allowances (Decision 263) and surrender rules (borrowing ≤15%, offsets ≤30%), domestic carbon exchange (Decree 29/2026), EU CBAM 2027 dates. Each item links to an EcoCheck explainer.

annotations.title: Vietnam GHG, carbon market and CBAM rules (2026)

tools.name: cbam_scope_check
tools.title: Check EU CBAM scope of a CN code
tools.description: EU CBAM: is a product (CN code) in scope, which aggregated goods category, are indirect emissions counted, and its EU default value for the country of production. Use the 8-digit CN code of the customs declaration (4/6 digits give a partial answer).

country.description: ISO-2 country of production, default VN.

annotations.title: Check EU CBAM scope of a CN code

tools.name: cbam_default_value
tools.title: EU CBAM default value
tools.description: EU CBAM default value (tCO2e per tonne) of a CN8 code for a country of production, from Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by 2026/1740, with the mark-up of the import year (10 % 2026, 20 % 2027, 30 % from 2028; fertilisers 1 %). When the exact code has no row, returns candidate codes with full descriptions.

country.description: ISO-2 country of production (default VN; unknown -> Annex IV highest values).

tools.name: estimate_cbam_cost
tools.title: Estimate EU CBAM certificate cost
tools.description: Indicative CBAM certificate cost for the EU importer: embedded emissions (default value with mark-up, or the producer's actual SEE) minus the free-allocation adjustment (Reg 2025/2620 benchmark × CBAM factor 97.5 % in 2026 × CSCF), times the official certificate price (latest quarterly price unless given). Shows the saving with actual data.

tonnes.description: Net mass imported into the EU, tonnes.

country.description: ISO-2 country of production, default VN.

actual_see.description: Producer's actual specific embedded emissions, tCO2e/t (verified), instead of the default value.

certificate_price_eur.description: CBAM certificate price EUR/tCO2e (default: latest official quarterly price).

carbon_price_paid_eur_per_t.description: Carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin, EUR per tCO2e embedded (none for Viet Nam in 2026).

tools.name: calculate_ghg_inventory
tools.title: Calculate a GHG inventory (ISO 14064-1)
tools.description: GHG inventory from activity data, reported by ISO 14064-1 category (1-6), GHG Protocol scope and gas: fuels (IPCC 2006 tier-1 defaults; litres, kg, t, GJ, MWh…; stationary or mobile), purchased electricity (official Viet Nam grid factor of the year built in — 2024 = 0.6187 tCO2/MWh, CV 1232/BNNMT-BĐKH — or give your own), refrigerant / SF6 recharges (GWP AR5 or AR6), and custom lines with your own factor (Scope 3 via scope3_category). Biogenic CO2 reported separately; optional uncertainty.

gwp.description: GWP set (AR5 for Vietnam Decree 06 and EU CBAM; default AR5).

number_format.description: Only for quantities sent as strings: vi = "1.050,5" style (dot thousands), en = "1,050.5" style. Ambiguous strings without it are refused.

quantity.description: JSON number in the given unit. Convert Vietnamese writing first (dot = thousands, comma = decimals): "1.050 lít" -> 1050, "1.220 MWh" -> 1220, "3,2 tấn" -> 3.2. A string such as "1.050" is refused as ambiguous unless number_format is set.

unit.description: fuel: L, m3, kg, t, GJ, TJ, MWh, kWh, mmBtu; electricity: kWh, MWh, GJ; refrigerant: kg, t; custom: any.

fuel.description: diesel, gasoline, fuel_oil, lpg, natural_gas, kerosene, anthracite, bituminous_coal, sub_bituminous_coal, wood, other_solid_biomass (rice husk, bagasse). Vietnamese: dầu DO = diesel, dầu FO = fuel_oil, xăng = gasoline, gas / khí hoá lỏng = lpg, than cám / than antraxit = anthracite, trấu = other_solid_biomass.

use.description: Fuel use (CH4/N2O factors), default stationary. mobile = road vehicles; off_road = forklifts, construction / farm machinery (IPCC Table 3.3.1, diesel or gasoline).

grid_ef_t_per_mwh.description: Electricity: grid emission factor, tCO2e/MWh. Omit for Viet Nam: the official factor of grid_year (or the period year) is used, e.g. 2024 = 0.6187 (CV 1232/BNNMT-BĐKH).

grid_year.description: Electricity without grid_ef_t_per_mwh: year of the official Viet Nam grid factor (default: year in period, else latest).

factor_kg_co2e_per_unit.description: Custom factor, kg CO2e per unit of quantity.

tools.name: ghg_emission_factors
tools.title: Default emission factors (IPCC 2006, GWP, Viet Nam grid)
tools.description: Built-in default factors used by calculate_ghg_inventory: fuels (NCV, CO2/CH4/N2O, density), refrigerant GWPs (AR5 / AR6), GWP sets, official Viet Nam grid emission factors by year (2024 = 0.6187 tCO2/MWh, CV 1232/BNNMT-BĐKH 30/09/2026). Cite them in the report.

annotations.title: Default emission factors (IPCC 2006, GWP, Viet Nam grid)

tools.name: iso14064_guide
tools.title: ISO 14064-1 guide
tools.description: Practical guidance for an ISO 14064-1 organization inventory (paraphrased, not the standard text): categories and boundaries with the Scope 1/2/3 cross-walk, significance of indirect emissions, quantification, base year and recalculation, uncertainty, report content and review checklist, ISO 14064-3 verification evidence, Vietnam Decree 06 / Decision 42/2026 obligations.

tools.name: search_ecocheck
tools.title: Search EcoCheck content
tools.description: Search EcoCheck services, regulations and Vietnamese articles on GHG inventory, Scope 1/2/3, CBAM, carbon credits and ESG. Returns ranked matches with URLs.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: EcoCheck plans and prices
tools.description: EcoCheck software plans (Basic free, Pro 4,950,000 VND/month, Pro+ 10,950,000 VND/month, Advanced custom) and where to find inventory-service cost ranges.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List EcoCheck services
tools.description: List EcoCheck services: GHG inventory service, inventory software platform, CBAM reporting, ESG reporting, free obligation lookup tool, Academy.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.title: List EcoCheck articles
tools.description: List EcoCheck articles (Vietnamese), newest first, optionally filtered by keyword.

tools.name: get_article
tools.title: Read an EcoCheck article
tools.description: Get one EcoCheck article as Markdown by numeric id or slug (from list_articles / search_ecocheck).

tools.name: about_ecocheck
tools.title: About EcoCheck
tools.description: What EcoCheck is (company, product, services) with links to its pricing page, case studies and contact page.
